profile.headline: Experienced Software Engineer, Data Driven Applications
profile.summary:
Established professional with a proven track record of developing robust solutions to complex
business and technical challenges, with an emphasis on data-driven techniques. 8+ years of software
development experience. Fast and flexible learner of new tools, techniques, and ideas; goal-oriented
and driven. Strong soft skills developed through teaching, coaching, training, and interdisciplinary
collaboration.
